Hi Emily —

Hope you're doing well. As we approach your renewal, we'd like to combine the QBR with a short product roadmap demo focused on performance and cost controls for inference workloads. Goal is to:

- Highlight new batching/caching controls that could reduce token cost for AtlasHealth by ~15%
- Walk through Dedicated vs. Private deployment options relevant to your compliance needs
- Capture any open action items for your renewal committee

Two asks from our side: 1) confirm who from Atlas should attend (technical and procurement), and 2) a ~45-minute window that works for your broader team next week. We can bring: Marissa (CS lead) for the QBR narrative and Jonas (product) for the roadmap/demos.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 7/20 10:00–10:45
- Tue 7/20 15:30–16:15
- Wed 7/21 11:00–11:45

I'll attach an agenda and the demo slide deck if that helps.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
